free_tier.stated: Upload files up-to 10 GB anonymously; free/non-account files kept for 14 days.
free_tier.notes: The FAQ says uploading and downloading is free for all users; no total storage or download byte allowance is printed.

per_object_cap.stated: Each file you upload must be less than 10 GB in size for free/non accounts or less than 100 GB in size for premium accounts.
per_object_cap.notes: bytes = 10 x 1024^3 for free and non-account uploads; premium is 100 GB.

retention.stated: Free/non accounts files are kept for 14 days. Premium accounts files are kept for unlimited days.

egress.terms: No download byte allowance or speed figure is printed on the pages read.

interface_detail: Web upload with a register_non_user route; the vendor documents a REST upload API at https://api.cyberfile.me/api/v2/file/upload using an access_token and account_id from /authorize. The api.cyberfile.me hostname did not resolve from a plain client on 2026-11-25.
tooling: Browser upload and a documented REST file-upload API requiring an access_token and account_id; the api.cyberfile.me endpoint did not resolve from a plain client on 2026-11-25.
chaining: 10 GB anonymous files kept 14 days: a hand-off point for one large file, not storage.

limits.value: 10 GB free and non-account, 100 GB premium
14 days free and non-account, unlimited premium

binding_note: 14-day deletion on the free tier bounds how long a file can be fetched; the 10 GB cap is second.

identity_cost.detail: The homepage says 'Upload files up-to 10 GB anonymously' and offers an optional Register to link uploads to an account.

reliability_note: The /upgrade page answered with the homepage, so no premium price was readable.
confidence_note: FAQ and homepage read on the vendor site on 2026-11-03. Premium price unverified: the upgrade page redirected to the homepage.
